zh-CN.title: 空间认证与容量分级
items: 空间后台新增管理员手机认证与实名认证申请
认证档位会清晰展示 5、100 或 500 人容量
未认证空间的广场与受限媒体入口会自动收起

en.title: Tiered space verification and capacity
items: Space administration now supports phone verification and identity review submissions
Verification tiers clearly show capacity for 5, 100, or 500 members
Square and restricted media entries are automatically hidden for unverified spaces
